research_period: Shows 10 September to 6 October 2026; Haute Couture, July 2026; Premiere Vision Paris, February 2026; analysis October to November 2026
markets: Global: New York, London, Milan, Paris and Copenhagen runways; premium and mid-market womenswear
title: SS27 Women's Trim Stories
summary: The trims that carry each SS27 women's theme: ribbon and rolled hems for One-Layer Summer, lace and satin bows for Lingerie as Outerwear, belts and peplum seams for The Waist Returns, and lace, smocking and embroidery for Handcraft.

sections.heading: One-Layer Summer
sections.body: Narrow rolled hems and French seams keep sheer cloth clean<sup>[1]</sup>; ribbon binding replaces facings; organza petals, as at Dior, give decoration without weight<sup>[2]</sup>. Hardware stays minimal so a look still reads as one layer.

sections.heading: Lingerie as Outerwear
sections.body: Lace trims, satin bows and adjustable straps, with hook-and-eye and visible lingerie fastenings. Fendi showed lace-trimmed bras with a fur stole<sup>[2]</sup>; Première Vision highlighted dark Leavers lace and lace with a melted-film sheen<sup>[3]</sup>. Bra tops need lingerie components: firm elastic top edges and adjustable sliders.

sections.heading: The Waist Returns
sections.body: Belts carry the waist story: Anteprima, Ferragamo, Alberta Ferretti and Ermanno Scervino cinched fluid pieces, Bottega Veneta and Max Mara used leather belts, and Ferragamo enlarged belts and covered snap buttons in sequins<sup>[4]</sup>. Add peplum seams, basque-waist panels and belt loops.

sections.heading: Handcraft
sections.body: Lace flowers, smocking and embroidery on poplin and knits. Première Vision's "Drawn" embroidery direction, with scattered, childlike florals and grass stems on tulle and gauze<sup>[3]</sup>, and Chanel's corsages<sup>[2]</sup> point the way.

sections.heading: In Motion
sections.body: Fringe and tassels: Roksanda showed tasselled evening dresses and Ahluwalia fringed skirts, and fringe was a fast-rising detail in Copenhagen<sup>[1]</sup>. Use fringe at hems and on scarves where movement shows it.

design_implications:
- Choose one trim family per theme and use it consistently across the theme's pieces.
- Lab-dip trims to the garment colour; lace and ribbon in particular vary by dye lot.
- Test attachment strength and washing for petals, beads and fringe.
commercial_implications:
- Trims are the cheapest way to make core shapes read as a theme; plan one core skirt or shirt in several theme trims.
- Sell belts, corsages and bows separately as add-ons.
